note: Stanislaus NF campground near the Clark Fork of the Stanislaus River, about 5 miles up Clark Fork Road from Hwy 108, run by Dodge Ridge Mountain Resort. Two paved loops: A (vault toilets, water at hydrants) and B (flush toilets); an RV water fill and the dump station are at the entrance. Near Clark Fork Horse Camp and the Iceberg Meadow Trailhead. --Claude
summary: Clark Fork (Stanislaus NF): FS page + rec.gov search + alerts + Google + Esri/3DEP. Confirmed $29, 88 sites, first-come (rec.gov listing not bookable), vault+flush toilets, dump; added 32-ft RV/trailer max, 6-person cap, 14-night limit, May-Oct season. Not waterfront kept (loops unlocatable under canopy; all points 300-450 m from the river). Website and phone flags.
flags: WEBSITE: stored link is the forest root. Old -> new: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/stanislaus -> https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/stanislaus/recreation/clark-fork-campground

PHONE: 209-965-3434 is the Sugar Pine (formerly Summit) Ranger District; the campground's own operator line on the FS page (and Google) is Dodge Ridge Mountain Resort 209-965-3474. Proposed 209-965-3434 -> 209-965-3474.

FACILITIES: the FS page contradicts itself on water ('Water is available at hydrants serving several sites' in the A-loop text vs 'Potable water is not available at this site. RV Water Filling Station ... at the entrance' in the amenity block). Stored potable_water true left alone.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' kept. The FS says 'Along the banks of the Clark Fork', but the loops can't be seen under canopy and the stored pin, the FS point and the Google point all sit 300-450 m from the river channel on 3DEP (11-14 m above it); no site can be shown near the water.
BOOKING: recreation.gov's search carries a non-reservable 'Clark Fork Campground' record (245556) with no bookable page, so the campground is first-come only.
